description: Linux kernel module source code for u-boot environment management in RAM, including device registration, memory mapping, and IO control functions.

methods.name: to_ubootenv_drvdata
methods.description: Converts file private data to ubootenv_drvdata structure.

methods.name: ubootenv_write
methods.description: Handles writing data to u-boot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_read
methods.description: Handles reading data from u-boot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_llseek
methods.description: Handles seeking within u-boot environment data.

methods.name: ubootenv_ioctl
methods.description: Handles IOCTL commands for u-boot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_probe
methods.description: Initializes the u-boot environment device during driver probe.

methods.name: ubootenv_remove
methods.description: Cleans up the u-boot environment device during driver removal.
